title: First Steps
description: Short, practical lessons for the first weeks of following Jesus: who God is, grace, prayer, reading the Bible, church, baptism and communion, and living it out.

title: The Big Story
description: The Bible is one long story about God, his people and his world. Walk through it from the first page to the last and see how it all fits together.

title: How We Got the Bible
description: Who wrote the Bible, how it was copied and collected, why different churches have different lists of books, and how it reached English.

title: How We Got Here
description: From a handful of believers in Jerusalem to a worldwide family of churches: persecution, creeds, splits, reform and mission.

title: How to Read the Bible
description: Learn to read each part of the Bible the way it was meant to be read, and avoid the most common mistakes.

title: Big Questions
description: Suffering, science, other religions, the reliability of the Gospels, the resurrection and doubt: what thoughtful Christians have said, fairly and honestly.
